# Summa-UI guidance 0.1.0

Initial approved baseline. Approved by the owner (FarmaanFJM) on 2026-10-28.

## Contents
22 principles (P01 to P22), 16 anti-patterns (AP-001 to AP-016), 8 interaction presets, 22 check rules and 10 human judgment prompts, design tokens with roles, a curated set of 165 Lucide icons (ISC), a compact prompt pack for Executor agents, JSON schemas, and framework-neutral CSS and HTML examples.

## How to consume
Pin by `bundleDigest` (see `manifest.json` and `docs/releases/guidance-v0.1.0.json` in the Summa-UI repository). Never consume `main` or an unreleased branch. See `docs/SUMMA_INTEGRATION.md`.

## Provisional
- `preset.notification`: the visual design is provisional until the owner reviews it against the owner's toast reference.

## Known limitations
See `knownLimitations` in `manifest.json`. None blocks this initial approval.

## Changes
First release. No earlier approved version exists.
